info.description: Command line tool for administering DataHub instances.

commands.name: install
commands.description: Install a dynamic CLI tool package.

options.name: --version
options.description: Exact NuGet package version to install

options.name: --source
options.description: NuGet package source

options.name: --prerelease
options.description: Allow prerelease versions when resolving latest [default: False]

options.name: --yes
options.description: Install without confirmation [default: False]

commands.name: list
commands.description: List installed dynamic CLI tool packages.

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Remove an installed dynamic CLI tool package.

options.name: --yes
options.description: Remove without confirmation [default: False]

commands.name: restore
commands.description: Restore installed dynamic CLI tool packages.

commands.name: add
commands.description: Add or update a DataHub profile.

options.name: --url
options.description: DataHub CLI endpoint URL.

options.name: --tenant
options.description: Microsoft Entra tenant id.

options.name: --scope
options.description: DataHub API delegated scope.

options.name: --yes
options.description: Remove the profile without prompting. [default: False]
